sample_family: NORTH / NRTH / NVX (MTA:SA loader + overlay menu)
notes: Indicators are evidence-backed from static analysis. No network indicators were observed in the samples. Strings inside NRTH.dll are XOR/SSE-encrypted at rest and only some plaintext copies exist in .rdata; file-level string matching on the DLL may miss variants that change the encryption key.

behavioral_signatures.name: SeDebugPrivilege acquisition
behavioral_signatures.false_positive_notes: Legitimate admin/debug tools also do this; only suspicious in combination with injection APIs.

behavioral_signatures.name: Classic cross-process DLL injection chain
behavioral_signatures.false_positive_notes: Standard software packers/updaters and accessibility tools can look similar; correlate with target process = game client and payload export name.

behavioral_signatures.name: Hook-style DLL injection fallback (bypass of OpenProcess denial)
behavioral_signatures.false_positive_notes: Many legit IME/overlay tools use SetWindowsHookEx; the combination with a game target + export named NVXHookProc + verification via EnumProcessModules is the stronger signal.

behavioral_signatures.name: Module pinning + LdrLoadDll inline hook (MinHook) with encrypted strings
behavioral_signatures.false_positive_notes: Pin + ntdll loader-hook + encrypted config strings together are uncommon in legitimate mods.

behavioral_signatures.name: D3D9 Present/Reset detour with ImGui overlay
behavioral_signatures.evidence: vtable slot 17 (0x44) / slot 16 (0x40) hooks; 'Dear ImGui 1.92.9 WIP (19283)'; toggle key 'Insert'
behavioral_signatures.false_positive_notes: Legit overlays (Steam, Discord, MSI Afterburner, ReShade) also hook Present; assess combined context and the self-name 'North Cheat'.

behavioral_signatures.name: MTA:SA-specific interop
behavioral_signatures.false_positive_notes: These MTA netcode identifiers inside a third-party DLL not signed by MTA strongly indicate cheat-framework interop.

strings_high_value.value: [+] Inyectado OK por hook (modulo verificado en el proceso).
[*] Hook completado. Entra al juego y pulsa INSERT: si sale el menu, quedo.

network_indicators.note: No C2 URLs, IPs, sockets, or download logic were observed in static triage of either sample. MTA:SA PACKET_ID_* constants relate to the game's own protocol structures; whether the payload manipulates live traffic is Unknown (U) and needs private-server net telemetry.
